═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
TRADE WATCHDOG — GOOD
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════

Open Trades: 3 (3 long, 0 short)
Unrealized PnL: +0.01 USDT
Regime: structure UP (BTC 1m above EMA300 ~80590 for 2.9h) + alt tape
FLIPPED LONG this cycle (regime_5m 17:45: 104L/2S/17N, was 44S/9L/68N
at 17:15 — verified in candles: 91/132 tokens +>0.1% in 40m) |
vol LOW | auto CHOP

── Steers ────────────────────────────────────────
🟡 HOLD #16395 BTC LONG while 1m closes hold above EMA300 ~80590
   (re-tested at write time: 347 consecutive above-ticks, spot +0.24%
   above); exit on 15+ min below. age=4 cycles unexecuted.
🟡 #16395: at trail arm ~80960 (+0.40% MFE) raise SL 79899 → 80476
   while structure holds. Currently +0.19%, unarmed. age=4 cycles.
🟡 RETRACTED — "EXIT #16397 DOGE LONG if regime_5m prints SHORT_BIAS
   for 2+ dumps while below +0.40% MFE" (condition reversed at 17:45:
   regime_5m flipped to LONG_BIAS 104/2/17, DOGE itself LONG_BIAS
   58.8; prior steer superseded — do not act on it).
🟡 Cluster (confirms steer-001): 3/3 long. Direction is now ALIGNED
   with both structure and the flipped tape — correlation risk
   unchanged: exit the UNARMED alt longs first IF regime_5m returns
   SHORT_BIAS for 2+ consecutive dumps while any is below +0.40% MFE.
🟢 #16397 DOGE: system guard armed — BB_BOUNCE_TRAIL_ARM_TIMEOUT
   (age≥55m AND live_pnl<0) fires ~17:56 UTC if still negative
   (-0.11% at 48m now). No manual action; if it arms to +0.40%
   (0.07778) before then, hold it.
🟢 #16399 KAS: thesis intact — strongest tape (regime_5m LONG_BIAS
   conf 91.9, +0.93% over 6h); BB_SQUEEZE_TRAIL_ARM_TIMEOUT (60m)
   fires ~18:34 UTC if it never arms. SL 0.93% at LOW vol is fine.
🟢 Flip rate measured this cycle: aggregate 21/24h, BTC 18/24h = p50
   normal — standing churn state, NOT a finding. Sources at 17:45:
   15m agg LONG_BIAS | regimes.BTC LONG_BIAS 59.3 | btc_4h LONG_BIAS
   | continuum ABOVE/LEAN_BULL | regime_5m LONG_BIAS 104/2/17 | auto
   CHOP.
🟢 GRASS watchlist pick (17:21) VOID on drift: rsi_at_pick 62.5 vs
   RSI 38.5 now (Δ24 > AI_TRADER_RSI_DRIFT_MAX 15); a GRASS SHORT
   fired 17:41. AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False anyway. No new pick this
   cycle (29 min < 45 min window).
🟢 Enforcement idle: no trade ≥2% / ≥5% / ≥8h (max +0.19%, max age
   2.0h) — profit-lock and stale rules have nothing to catch.

── Deep Analysis ─────────────────────────────────
BTC long was the aligned trade last cycle; this cycle the alt tape
joined it — the prior "longs fight the tape" conflict is RESOLVED, and
verified, not assumed: regime_5m 17:15 SHORT_BIAS 44/9/68 → 17:45
LONG_BIAS 104/2/17, cross-checked against raw candles (91/132 tokens
up >0.1% over 40m, only 16 down; MERL +2.70% flipped SHORT-conf-89 →
LONG 80.3, STX +2.60% LONG 84.9, INJ +1.91% LONG 95; only USELESS
still short). All three open longs now sit on the winning side of BOTH
structure (BTC 1m > EMA300 for 2.9h, continuum STRONG_UP/LEAN_BULL)
and the 5m tape.

The live risk is not direction — it is NEVER ARMING. Chop-bleed KPI is
at baseline: 7d 83.5% of gross loss comes from trades that never
reached +0.40% MFE, and the tape is LOW volume / SLOW velocity — no
follow-through energy. Arm thresholds: BTC 80960 (+0.40%), DOGE
0.07778, KAS 0.036503. The system's own trail-arm-timeouts cover DOGE
(~17:56) and KAS (~18:34); continuum-trend+ (BTC) has no arm-timeout
flag, so its guards are the EMA300 exit line plus the SL-at-arm steer
— still unexecuted at age=4 because the trade has not armed yet, not
because anyone ignored it.

Would I open these fresh today? BTC yes — structure and tape aligned.
KAS yes — strongest momentum of the three, but only with the 60m
timeout as the stall backstop. DOGE marginal — bb-bounce-v2-long+ is
the book's worst live long family (7d 19T 47.4% -$0.42; audited #138,
KILL BARS FAIL so it stays enabled), entry mid-band meta_rsi 51.7, and
at 48m it is -0.11% with its guard about to resolve it. SLs (0.9-1.0%
at LOW vol) are adequately placed on all three — none too tight, none
absurdly loose.

While checking the open book I also noticed the auto-trader's stale
BTC shadow short arm at 80057.7 (age 7.5h) — shadow-only, zero live
risk, but it is counter-tape under the current long tape; it will just
expire as data.

── Recommendations ───────────────────────────────
1. Keep #16395 on the EMA300 exit line (~80590, re-tested this cycle);
   raise SL 79899 → 80476 the moment it arms at ~80960.
2. Let #16397's 55m arm-timeout run (~17:56) — do not manually hold a
   negative mid-band bb-bounce entry past its guard.
3. No intervention on #16399 — hold while it grinds toward 0.036503;
   timeout covers the stall case at 18:34.
4. New size: auto-trader still CHOP + volume_regime LOW — keep added
   longs discretionary; re-test when auto leaves CHOP or volume
   normalizes (condition-keyed, next cycle).
5. Pick: none this cycle (prior GRASS pick 29 min old and void on RSI
   drift; AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False — watchlist-only regardless).

══ PATTERN 1 — chop-bleed KPI (north star: entering in chop?) ══

  14d  85.4%  (148T -$13.21 of 191T -$15.46)
  30d  80.6%  (260T -$28.23 of 357T -$35.03)
Baseline 2026-10-25: 84.1 / 85.6 / 80.6 → AT baseline, no drift.
Thresholds: ≤70% = exit ownership (route UGB-PT/trail); ≥92% = entry
quality deteriorating (route entry gates). At 83.5% we sit in the
entry-quality zone: ownership stays at ENTRY gates, not exit tweaks.
Never cross-compare windows.

══ PATTERN 2 — 7d direction split (the book in two halves) ══

  SHORT  37T  18W 48.6%  +$0.42
